title: TaskGroup
description: Schema for a planner-agent task group file. See .claude/PROTOCOL.md for full contract.

group.description: Stable snake_case identifier for this group (e.g. 'voter_management'). Immutable after creation.

summary.description: One sentence describing what the group achieves end-to-end.

depends_on_tasks.description: Stable group ids (not filenames) of groups that must be fully done before this group starts.

id.description: Unique task identifier in format GROUP-NNN (e.g. VOTER-001, VOTER-REV-1).

title.description: Short imperative sentence describing what must be done.

marker.description: Bare token dispatch key. See PROTOCOL.md Marker Vocabulary for agent routing.

depends_on.description: IDs of tasks (sibling or cross-group) that must be done before this task starts.

skills.description: Skill names the worker must activate (e.g. ['implement-service', 'implement-mapper']).

files.description: File and type footprint of this task.

touches.description: Repo-relative paths this task creates or modifies.

depends_on_types.description: Fully-qualified types or generated symbols (e.g. OpenAPI DTOs) this task needs as input. Empty array if none.

instruction.description: What to build, as a short ordered list of steps. Each entry should fit on one line.

acceptance_criteria.description: Everything that must hold true when the task is done — both spec constraints (e.g. 'No @Transactional') and behavioral checks (e.g. 'Returns 409 when voter is BLOCKED'). Non-empty on DEVELOP/TEST; empty array on CONFIG/REVIEW.

api_format.description: MUST be set on [API] tasks only. Omit entirely on non-API tasks.

user_stories_covered.description: MUST be set on [REVIEW] tasks only. Lists user stories verified in this review.

spec_ref.description: Pointer to the architect spec sections relevant to this task.

doc.description: Repo-relative path to the architecture document (e.g. '.flow/2-architecture/01_voter_management.md').

sections.description: Stable section heading anchors within the doc (e.g. ['## Service Layer']).

status.description: Current task status. Planner always writes 'pending'. Only the Orchestrator sets 'done'. See PROTOCOL.md Status State Machine.

review_verdict.description: Set by reviewer-agent on [REVIEW] tasks once reviewed. Absent until then.

rework_tasks.description: Task IDs that need rework after a REQUEST_CHANGES verdict. Added by reviewer-agent only when non-empty.
